title.en: The One With Loving You Is Living

description.es: Marta va a la tienda por la noche, y ella y Fina hablan. Marta le dice a Fina que aceptó este acuerdo creyendo en el sueño de formar una familia con ella, pero que esta sociedad no les permitirá ser una familia, y que al final el amor de su vida, su mujer, habrá quedado excluida de su vida.
description.en: Marta comes to the store in the evening, and she and Fina talk. Marta tells Fina that she accepted this arrangement believing in the dream of building a family with her, but that this society will not allow them to be a family, and that in the end the love of her life, her wife, will have been shut out of her life.
